arms.baseline: Current runtime minus exactly the studied mechanism
arms.modified: Unmodified current runtime, identical version in all three panels
arms.cline: Integrated Cline from that same unmodified current runtime

selection: Six new internally constructed tasks on reused pinned real source repositories; no model has attempted these task IDs. Not random external issues or previously unseen repositories. Known diagnostics and local controls remain separate. No replacement tasks or post-result paid retries.

hypotheses.f21: Bounded recovery helps repair eligible scoped rejections; measure all task outcomes, rejection-to-correction steps, returned bytes and resources. No natural activation means no effectiveness conclusion; never select only exposed runs for the primary estimate.
hypotheses.f22: Header-only reading improves complete exact API inventories without changing source or losing declared type information. Measure requested/rendered views, header bytes, JSON correctness, tokens/cost/time at matched audited quality.
hypotheses.f23: Salient active-case caption improves the requested final report. Both arms keep identical structured Node events, invocation bindings, exclusive report directories and guards; only appended caption differs. Measure actual cases versus final model counts, alongside code/test task success.

decision: Keep all failures/timeouts/missing usage and planned unexecuted rows. Use all assigned rows for primary success; compare resources only on audit-success/accounting-matched pairs. Report within-task repeat variation and between-task heterogeneity separately. Two tasks and two repetitions are a limited confirmation, not a population or global proof. A confidence interval crossing no improvement is inconclusive, not equivalence. Output bounds may regress long-generation quality.
accounting: Reserve .04 session + .23 final request. Serialized request <=290000 bytes; conservative input300000 tokens at .25/M plus output128000 at1.2/M = .2286. Configured8192 remains only nominal on OAuth. Estimates not invoices; unknown hidden retries/provider framing/full cache. Stop before admission above .50 with missing usage reserved .27.

commonBuildConfiguration.reason: All arms compile the same production module set. Feature tests calling a removed typed API are not counterfactual production modules; separate differential controls verify retained guards.

operationalAmendment.priorCompletedPanel: f22, unchanged original protocol and execution bindings
operationalAmendment.finding: Actual OAuth transport omits configured max_output_tokens; offline API-key preflight was not representative. No claim of provider-enforced8192 limit.
operationalAmendment.response: Common pre-dispatch290000-byte JSON request budget; rejects rather than truncates. Reserve full catalog128000 output tokens and10000 framing/input tokens plus at most one token per serialized byte at worst uncached/cache-write price. No provider invoice guarantee or bound on hidden server framing/retries. Byte budget is a common benchmark constraint; report any activation as a failure and do not pool constrained comparisons with F22.
